costumes.name: Anchor the Diver
costumes.description:
Anchor costume.
Obtained from AEGIS THE DIVER.

lines.text: I like the sea. Seawater... not so much.
Oh jeez, Helm is really gonna let me have it now.
Ugh... I'm soaked.
Captain, could you help me wring the water out?

Do you know the human body is made up mostly of water?
A little bit of trivia for you.
Don't tell Helm that I went swimming.
What are you up to, Captain? Wanna go see some starfish?

I'll be fishing while you're away.
I usually catch a lot fairly quickly, so don't be too long.
I suppose Helm wouldn't be pleased if I put a starfish or sea cucumber in the swimming pool.
Electromagnetic waves from the radio tower give me a headache.
Can I take a dip in the swimming pool?

I'm Anchor from Aegis.
Would you like a starfish, Captain?
Cool, my surveillance capabilities have been enhanced... I think? At least they should be.
I'll put this power to good use... fishing!
Thanks. Do you want a sea cucumber?
Is it a starfish? It must be. Aw nuts, it's not...
Can I use this as bait?
*Beep* Probe launched. Not showing any sea cucumbers. How unfortunate.
Spending a day fishing with you would be awesome, Captain.
You're so cool, Captain. You're as cool as, like 100 sea cucumbers!
How do you feel when you see me, Captain? I feel this electricity every time we meet.
Are we going to the beach?
Huh?
Commencing detection...
Whoa, the starfish is on the move.
I could really use some fish.
Do you like fishing, Captain?
Have you ever seen kelp? They're very interesting to observe.
A sea cucumber's homeliness is part of its charm.
Can't I just go on the back of a flying fish?
I want to build a house for hermit crabs.
Yeah, that's the stuff.
Is this... oh yeah, that's it.
You see that? Just shoot in that direction.
Sea squirt!
Sea anemone!
Styela clava!
Eah.
*Sob*
Aargh!
That's it, I'm going back to Atlantis.
It's over. Wanna go fishing? Playing with some starfish is okay, too.

Beep-beep. Movement from large object detected at 12 o'clock...
Oh... It was you, Captain?
I wonder what kind of creatures lie deep in the ocean?
I like this outfit because it's quite moisture-resistant.
I caught a pufferfish, would you like to eat it together with me?
Don't tell anyone, but I attached a sea cucumber to the bottom of the Admire.
You remind me of a sea squirt.
At this rate, all the starfish are gonna run away.
Is this going to take long? I'd prefer to go for a swim together.
The fact that these clothes cling to my body actually helps with my detection abilities.
It sure would be nice if some sea creatures could move to the Outpost.
What's this I'm holding? It's a starfish. Do you want to see it?
I'm going to catch a rainbow sea squirt if it's the last thing I do!
This is great! Do you think I could talk to the starfish now?
Now I can swim faster.
Thank you. Would you like to go diving with me?

Thanks, Captain.
Let's see... I can give you a sea urchin in return.
Can I share this with the starfish?
Hehe. Next time, please get me a sea cucumber.
I want to stick to you like a barnacle.
This signal makes me feel tingly. I've never felt anything like this before...
Next time, I'll give you the starfish I cherish the most.
Anchor, ready to dive.
To the deeper depths!
Keep your eyes peeled, everyone.
Hold on, something's moving over there...
I think I'll go a bit deeper today.
We need to finish before the starfish dries out.
Beep-beep. Multiple movements detected up ahead!
Last night, I dreamed I was a clam.
Can't I like get gills or something?
I wonder what texture squid ink has...
Hmm... this signal is...
Something about these coordinates seems off...
Fire at the coordinates I gave to you.
Sea urchin!
Sea cucumber!
Squid!
Urgh.
Argh.
Ouch.
Argh... Need more... oxygen...
Sweet! Now I can swim all day long!
